cases.sentence: В последние дни ___ Дома Господня станет высочайшей среди гор.
cases.translation: The mountain of Yahweh's house shall be established on the top of the mountains.
cases.explain: The verb станет (shall become) with accusative shows the object of transformation.

cases.translation: Hear Yahweh's word, you rulers of the peoples.
cases.explain: The genitive множественное число народов is used to show the rulers belong to the peoples.

cases.sentence: Ведь из Сиона выйдет ___, и слово Господне из Иерусалима.
cases.translation: For the law shall go out of Zion.
cases.explain: The verb выйдет (shall come out) with accusative object shows what comes forth.

cases.sentence: Перекуют они мечи на плуги и ___ на серпы.
cases.translation: They shall beat their spears into pruning hooks.
cases.explain: The verb перекуют (shall forge) requires the accusative plural копья for the direct object.

cases.sentence: Их земля полна ___ и золота, нет числа их сокровищам.
cases.translation: Their land is full of silver and gold.
cases.explain: The adjective полна (full) with genitive indicates what the land is full of; полна серебра.

cases.sentence: Их земля полна ___, они кланяются делам своих рук.
cases.translation: Their land is full of idols.
cases.explain: The adjective полна (full) with genitive requires идолов in plural genitive.

cases.sentence: Не защищают они сироту, дело ___ до них не доходит.
cases.translation: They do not defend the fatherless, and the cause of the widow does not come to them.
cases.explain: The genitive людей is used to show possession; 'the widow's cause' requires the genitive.

cases.translation: They worship the work of their own hands.
cases.explain: The verb кланяются (worship) with dative requires делам in plural dative.

reading.ru: В последние дни гора Дома Господня станет высочайшей среди гор.
reading.question: What will happen to the mountain of Yahweh's house in the latter days?
options: It shall be established as the highest among all mountains
It will become lower than other mountains
reading.correct: It shall be established as the highest among all mountains
reading.explain: The text explicitly states: 'гора Дома Господня станет высочайшей среди гор.'

reading.ru: Идем, поднимемся на Господню гору, к дому Бога Иакова. Он научит нас своим путям, и мы будем ходить по его тропам.
reading.question: Why will the nations want to go to the mountain of the Lord?
options: To be taught God's ways and to walk in His paths
reading.correct: To be taught God's ways and to walk in His paths
reading.explain: The nations will come 'чтобы Он научит нас своим путям, и мы будем ходить по его тропам.'

reading.ru: Перекуют они мечи на плуги и копья на серпы. Не поднимет народ на народ меча, и не будут больше учиться войне.
reading.question: What transformation will occur among the nations according to this verse?
options: Weapons will be converted to farm tools and nations will cease making war
reading.correct: Weapons will be converted to farm tools and nations will cease making war
reading.explain: The text describes a complete transformation: weapons become tools and nations stop waging war.

reading.ru: Их земля полна серебра и золота, нет числа их сокровищам.
reading.question: What does the text say about the wealth of the people?
options: Their land is filled with silver, gold, and countless treasures
They have no wealth at all
They have only silver but no gold
reading.correct: Their land is filled with silver, gold, and countless treasures
reading.explain: The text emphasizes abundance: 'Их земля полна серебра и золота, нет числа их сокровищам.'

reading.ru: Их земля полна коней, нет числа колесницам их.
reading.question: What does the text say about their military capabilities?
options: They have countless horses and chariots
reading.correct: They have countless horses and chariots
reading.explain: The parallel construction states: 'нет числа' (without number/countless) for both horses and chariots.

reading.ru: Иди в скалы, спрячься в прахе от страха Господа и от славы его величия.
reading.question: What is the response of people when God rises to shake the earth?
options: They hide in rocks and dust from terror of God and His glory
reading.correct: They hide in rocks and dust from terror of God and His glory
reading.explain: The text describes hiding 'от страха Господа и от славы его величия' when He arises to shake the earth.
